About

Rudrani Regency is a G+5 hospitality project in Gangarampur, West Bengal, developed by ADS Creative Space from an existing structural framework. The scope covered floor planning, exterior façade design and complete interior design, transforming the unfinished structure into a cohesive hospitality destination.

The project brings together a banquet hall, restaurants, rooftop dining, reception, guest rooms and suites, each designed with its own character while maintaining a consistent architectural identity. Contemporary forms, warm wood finishes, contrasting materials and layered lighting define the overall design.

From spatial planning and furniture selection to lighting, finishes and even crockery, attention was given to every detail, creating a balance of functionality, comfort and visual appeal throughout the property.

Under the Stars — Rooftop Dining
An atmospheric rooftop dining destination where contemporary design meets warm, ambient lighting. Textured stone finishes, sculptural screens, pergola detailing, and thoughtfully arranged seating create an inviting setting for relaxed dining and evening gatherings. A balanced palette of natural textures and modern elements defines the space, transforming the rooftop into a distinctive hospitality experience.
Rudrani Regency | Signature Dining Experience
Conceived as a defining element of Rudrani Regency, the restaurant brings contemporary elegance to hospitality through a rich interplay of warm wood textures, sculptural fluted columns, geometric ceiling detailing, and softly illuminated architectural forms. A palette of earthy neutrals, refined upholstery, and layered ambient lighting creates a distinctive dining environment that balances visual sophistication with everyday comfort. The design reflects the project’s overarching identity: modern, welcoming, and thoughtfully crafted.
Rudrani Regency | Contemporary Architectural Expression
Defined by bold geometric forms, a sculptural curved façade, contrasting light and dark surfaces, and integrated accent lighting, Rudrani Regency presents a distinctive contemporary hospitality landmark in Gangarampur. The architectural composition balances clean lines with expressive curves, creating a memorable exterior identity that carries the project's design vision from the building envelope to its interior spaces.
Rudrani Regency | Grand Banquet Experience
Designed to make celebrations memorable, the banquet hall features a striking interplay of warm wood finishes, luminous yellow onyx-inspired panels, geometric mirrored detailing, and elegant circular ceiling features. A refined neutral palette, layered lighting, and a spacious, uninterrupted floor layout establish a sophisticated setting for weddings, social gatherings, and special occasions. The design brings architectural rhythm and visual grandeur together to create a distinctive event space within Rudrani Regency.
Rudrani Regency | A Signature Reception Experience
Designed as the welcoming focal point of Rudrani Regency, the reception brings together a sculptural ivory front desk, rich wood textures, marble-inspired finishes, and a striking interplay of geometric and curved forms. A dramatic illuminated ceiling feature, layered ambient lighting, and a bold stone floor inlay enhance the sense of arrival, while the custom backdrop establishes a distinctive visual identity for the hotel. The result is a contemporary reception space that balances elegance, functionality, and a memorable first impression.
Rudrani Regency | Suite Room — Refined Comfort & Contemporary Luxury
Designed to offer an elevated and relaxing guest experience, the suite room brings together a sophisticated material palette, thoughtfully coordinated furnishings, and carefully layered lighting. Warm wood accents, elegant surface finishes, and a harmonious balance of textures create an inviting atmosphere that blends contemporary aesthetics with everyday comfort. Every design element contributes to a cohesive private retreat, reflecting the hospitality and design identity of Rudrani Regency.
Highlights
Sculptural Reception Counter
A custom-designed ivory reception desk with flowing curves and vertical wood-slat detailing creates a striking focal point while maintaining a refined, welcoming character.
Signature Feature Wall
Layered geometric compositions and organic curves combine with warm wood finishes to frame the hotel signage and establish a distinctive visual identity.
Statement Ceiling Installation
A dramatic suspended ceiling feature with intricate geometric detailing and integrated illumination draws the eye upward and enhances the sense of arrival.
Decorative Stone Flooring
Contrasting dark, gold-veined and light marble-inspired surfaces create a bold circular floor motif that visually defines the reception zone.
Rich Material Composition
Warm wood textures, light stone finishes, and dark flooring establish a balanced palette that adds depth, sophistication, and visual continuity to the interior.
Layered Architectural Lighting
Concealed linear illumination, ceiling accents, and focused lighting work together to highlight architectural forms, enhance material textures, and create a welcoming atmosphere.
